products.title: Pink Double-Sided Mahjong Mat
products.body_html:
Bring double the elegance to your game with our brand new reversible mahjong mat. That's two beautiful mats in one! One side features a delicate peony design in corals and reds on a light pink field. The other side is our Mahjong House flower border in coral on a pink field. This mat creates a stunning backdrop, especially to any tiles in our House Collection, adding warmth and charm to every game. Mats at The Mahjong House are designed to make each hand feel as special as the last.

Materials: Spandex & Rubber; Machine Washable: Dimensions: 31.5" x 31.5"

products.title: Hot Pink Island Border Mahjong Mat
products.body_html:
Dive into the beauty of the tropics with our Island Collection Mahjong Mat. Featuring a vibrant palette of tropical colors and an elegant border adorned with seashells and ocean-inspired designs, this mat brings the serenity of the seaside to your game. Perfect for creating a relaxed, breezy vibe, it’s an ideal backdrop for any Mahjong gathering. Let the soothing coastal charm of this mat transport you to your favorite island getaway with every hand.

PLEASE NOTE: The Mahjong House’s Island, Texas, and Classic collection products do not have branded/descriptive packaging; the tile sets each ship in a MAHJONG HOUSE drawstring bag and their mats ship without wrapping or labels.
